modules.name: Neighbours
modules.description: Mobile feature that lets a resident see limited details of other registered flats on the same floor of the same building.

requirements.title: Occupation field on registration and profile
requirements.description: Occupation can be entered (optional) at registration or in the profile.

requirements.title: Show me to neighbours setting
requirements.description: A resident can turn off the setting that shows them to neighbours. When it is off, neighbours see the flat number only.

requirements.title: Live update of neighbour list
requirements.description: When a main user changes their details, the neighbour list updates at once.

rules.title: Same floor only
rules.description: A resident sees only other registered flats on the same floor of the same building. For example, a resident on floor 4 of Building B sees only registered flats on floor 4 of Building B.

rules.title: Limited neighbour details
rules.description: A neighbour shows only flat number, main person's name and occupation. Phone, email, family and owner/tenant status are never shown.
